testCase:
S-10: The most helpful 1-star review
Goal: Mark as helpful the 1-star review of the Tevora Brew Pro 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker that the most people found helpful.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/s-10/
STEP 2: Open "Tevora Brew Pro 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker"
STEP 3: Open the "Reviews" tab
STEP 4: Filter the reviews to "1 star"
STEP 5: Click "Helpful" on the 1-star review with the most "people found this helpful"
STEP 6: Verify "Marked helpful: "Leaks from the base after three weeks"" is visible

args.text: Tevora Brew Pro 12-Cup Programmable Coffee Maker

steps.note: Compare helpful counts among the filtered reviews and mark the highest one helpful.

args.text: Marked helpful: "Leaks from the base after three weeks"

steps.note: Verify the expected review was marked helpful.

reasoning: This test checks that the most-helpful 1-star review can be marked helpful for the specified coffee maker. The plan filters reviews before comparing helpful counts, then verifies the requested confirmation without assuming which review wins.
